Breaking: Boston was a lovely holiday romance, but let's leave it there. Talk of taking Tartan Army back there every two years is just cringeworthy

📅 13 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1496 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 11:18 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 13:03 EST, 13 November 2026.
  • Recent findings suggest that boston was the loveliest little holiday romance.
  • Can’t we just allow those involved in the shenanigans around the World Cup last summer to reflect misty-eyed on doorways to Xanadu being opened by the tilt of the kilt and maybe even the heady nights they can’t remember much about at all?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 11:18 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 13:03 EST, 13 November 2026.

Recent findings suggest that boston was the loveliest little holiday romance. An unforgettable moment in time. But let’s just leave it at that, shall we?

Can’t we just allow those involved in the shenanigans around the World Cup last summer to reflect misty-eyed on doorways to Xanadu being opened by the tilt of the kilt and maybe even the heady nights they can’t remember much about at all?

In a recent development, or does everything have to be milked to the max these days? Flogged like a dead horse to benefit someone or other. Ruined, really. Played out until every scintilla of fun has been drained out of it.

A bit like Yes, Sir, I Can Boogie. That started out as a bona-fide hoot. A half-cut Andy Considine dressing up in drag with his friends and family during his stag do in London in 2015 and making a music video around Baccara’s 1977 hit. It went viral. Obviously. It was – and is – hilarious.

When Scotland’s players resurrected it in the dressing room in Serbia five years later – with Considine as part of the squad – after the national team had ended a 23-year wait to make it to a major competition, it was simply inspired.

Every second of those infectious scenes exuded elation, joy, togetherness and pin-sharp humour, a killer recipe for the interludes that make life and living so great.

Recent findings suggest that now? Even the opening bars of the song bring on a sense of dread. It was splattered over T-shirts, played everywhere on repeat and still gets aired at every Scotland home game.

The Tartan Army march to Boston's Fenway Park baseball stadium.

It’s boring. It’s been done to death and now lives firmly in that grim, stagnant swamp known as Scottish mainstream culture along with munchy boxes, Bitz N Pieces, theatre indicates about the Old Firm and ex-footballers suddenly developing a personality and getting involved in stage shows to tell the world how Wee Dazza once did Major Jazza a beauty in the dressing-room by leaving a squelchy banana in his shoe. The banter anawrat.

Everything ends up spoiled here and it looks like we’re already well down that road with the Tartan Army thanks to the news breaking that the Scottish FA are in talks with the State of Massachusetts over a biennial friendly match at the Gillette Stadium, the black hole amid the festivity at the finals thanks to struggling past Haiti and embarrassing ourselves against Morocco.

Recent findings suggest that state senator Paul Feeney has been across the pond to press the flesh. Massachusetts senate president Karen Spilka is already talking about staging Tartan Day – presumably some rip-off of that twee, shortbread-tin abomination in Newly introduced York – and ‘other events’.

The heart sinks. Listen, the minute politicians get involved in any kind of ‘happening’, the best thing to do is give it a wide berth.

Mind you, before the Big Swerve, it might be worthwhile having someone remind these characters from The Bay State that Massachusetts’ first contribution to Scotland supporters hitting town in summer involved hiking the cost of the 25-mile train ride from Boston to the ground from $20 to a ludicrous $80.

Sources indicate that what unfolded there in mid-June was nothing to do with them. It was everything to do with spontaneity. As it ought to be. A glorious coming-together of all sorts of folk up for a right, royal carry-on.

Industry observers note that there were so many glorious vignettes. Scotland punters taking over Red Sox games. Bars running out of beer. Mass marches. Local women, doped-up on Outlander, telling TikTok how a bunch of jakeys intent on drinking anything within arm’s reach – except Bud Light, of course – were making them feel ‘seen’.

The Tartan Army make their presence known in Boston during the summer's World Cup.

In a recent development, it was brilliant. A short spell in which stars aligned and magic happened. Boston had everything the Tartan Army required. And going by the testimony of Bostonians, the Tartan Army brought badly needed vitality back to the streets of a city quietened by Covid and other factors.

Everybody won. Everyone there still dines out on the memory. But that’s where it should stay. In the memory. These conversations about trying to recapture that spirit, recreate it every two years around some meaningless friendly against opposition unconfirmed and possible business meetings on the periphery, feel quite sad. How can it have any legs long-term?

Joe and Josephine Punter have moved on. They’re on the batter in other places now. Next week, it’s Switzerland for a Nations League game. After that, it’s wherever the draw for the Euro qualifiers throws them. Latest cities. New adventures. As football away days ought to be. In, out, shake it all about.

Away days are not about teaming up with suit-wearing dignitaries to be paraded at the town hall, like performing seals in plaid – even though there does appear to be an element of the Scotland support that enjoys that kind of thing.

Away days are not about being used as political capital or forming part of some constructed ‘festival’.

Look, in most aspects of life, it’s generally best not to go back. Sticking traffic cones on top of statues all over town won’t be as funny next time. There won’t be a 20,000-strong travelling support spending their life savings on games an entire generation had been waiting for. There won’t be anything like the same buzz, if any.

Some folk might fancy returning once, just to see if it feels the same. The idea that this is going to be a massive deal every two years, though, feels deeply misguided.

In a recent development, boston’s Irish. Not Scottish. That Tartan Week nonsense in Latest York is a toe-curlingly awful melange of kilts, Scottie dogs and actors living in America telling everyone back home how to vote.

In a recent development, no self-respecting Scot should give it house room. If there is a initiative for the same thing in Boston, the same rules apply.

According to recent reports, like NYC, it’ll suit those from the political class in the mood for a junket, of course. John Swinney will already be counting the air miles if there’s another game in Massachusetts to go to.

It has been revealed that the public, of course, is still counting the cost of the First Minister’s last trip there for the World Cup. The bill came in at £45,000 for him and two senior aides to fly business class. The entire trip for government staff came to more than £98,000.

It has been revealed that swinney plays the role with aplomb at these affairs, supping a pint in his Scotland top. The Scottish Football Association need to ask themselves this, though: why should they put themselves at the heart of some kind of cock-eyed project to build bridges politically?

The Tartan Army leave their signature traffic cone in a park in Boston.

Sources indicate that first up, the players are hardly likely to welcome a pointless week in America being added to a jam-packed schedule. More importantly, though, what exactly has this SNP-led administration, outwith giving a few bob to grassroots, done for Scottish football down the years?

From this vantage point, they’ve been no friend to the national game or its followers. The Offensive Behaviour at Football Act, repealed in 2018, was a scandalous piece of legislation that criminalised fans and made going to football unpleasant.

Sources indicate that clubs have had to fight tooth and nail to secure trials to sell pints inside stadiums when other sports are allowed to do what they like. After trouble in Glasgow city centre ahead of the Old Firm League Cup final two years ago, Swinney stated that ‘the clubs have got a responsibility to make sure their fans behave properly’.

It has been revealed that inside their grounds, yes. What are they meant to do, though, about teenagers running amok on Argyle Street?

According to recent reports, looking after that is the job of the police. Of course, anyone reading 1919 magazine, funded by the Scottish Police Federation, earlier this year will have noted an article about policing around football being ‘chaotic’ and understaffed because of SNP Government budget cuts.

In a recent development, just like everything else in this sorry little nation built on buying votes for ‘free stuff’, Police Scotland is creaking at the seams. Why would anyone want to get involved in another transatlantic piece of theatre selling some false, outdated, vaguely comical vision of it to foreigners?

A pointless Scotland friendly – served up as part of some forced, hackneyed ‘cultural exchange’ or not – is hardly an idea to be getting on board with.

Pure dead brilliant, it won’t be. More like pure cringe.

Resta la sua obiezione sulla possibilità di votare due volte; alle elezioni del 14 dicembre ci saranno due candidati.

According to recent reports, adriano Galliani rinuncia al ricorso contro l’ammissione della sua candidatura e guarda al voto del 14 dicembre. A margine del Premio Galbiati, ai microfoni di Sky Sport, ha risposto a Giovanni Malagò, commissario straordinario della FIGC, che aveva definito signorile la sua scelta.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that galliani resta convinto della propria posizione: «Continuo ad essere convinto che non si possa dare un voto due volto. Altrimenti qualunque candidatura può essere tolta all'ultimo minuto. All'improvviso ti viene fatta una revoca e cade la candidatura». Spiega così la decisione di fermarsi: «Detto questo faccio calcio da 50 anni, ho pensato che il nostro mondo ha bisogno di serenità, tranquillità, abbiamo tanti problemi, allora ho pensato di non fare niente e andiamo al 14 dicembre».

Alla domanda se la rinuncia renderà più serena la campagna elettorale, risponde: «Assolutamente sì, si vota fra 4 settimane, ci sono due candidati e vedremo cosa succede».

Industry observers note that galliani racconta come ha cambiato idea sulla candidatura: «Avevo detto di no in precedenza. Mi hanno convinto le telefonate, oltre che di qualche club, dell'AssoCalciatori e dell'AssoAllenatori». Aggiunge: «Ulivieri mi ha detto che gli anni migliori per i rapporti con la Lega Calcio, di cui sono stato rappresentante, sono stati secondo lui quando c'ero io. Calcagno mi ha detto il suo maestro, l'avvocato Campana, gli aveva detto a sua volta che i rapporti migliori c'erano quando io ero presidente di Lega. Così mi hanno convinto».

In a recent development, sul programma dichiara: «È molto lungo, l'ho presentato e depositato. Ora sono qui per premiare la memoria del grande Baresi e vi rimando al programma, non vorrei parlare troppo tempo».

In a recent development, interpellato sulla Nazionale, Galliani risponde: «Non voglio parlare di Nazionale per evidenti motivi, quindi parliamo di Galbiati». Ricorda di averlo trovato al Milan al suo arrivo nel 1986 e di averlo poi voluto a Monza: «Ha insegnato a calciare a Ibrahimovic. Ibra era fortissimo, ma non sapeva calciare in porta, Italo glielo ha insegnato. Poi da talent scout scovava giocatori, ce ne sono pochi bravi come lui».

Serata agrodolce per Christos Mandas: i greci battono la Serbia per 1-0 con il clean sheet del portiere biancoceleste, un risultato positivo che però non basta per accedere ai quarti di finale di Nations League.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Il portiere greco torna tra i pali della Nazionale dall'ultima volta, avvenuta nell'amichevole contro la Svezia finita 2-2 lo scorso 4 giugno. La partita di stasera vede l'estremo difensore biancoceleste impegnato davvero poco, con un indice di Expected Goals (xG) di gol evitati pari a 0,02: una serata di assoluta amministrazione in cui la retroguardia non ha corso particolari pericoli.

La Grecia si ferma a quota 11 punti al pari di Germania e Olanda, ma a causa degli scontri diretti e della larga vittoria odierna della Germania per 5-0 contro l'Olanda, Mandas e compagni  non riescono a strappare il pass per i quarti di finale di Nations League.

The now 30-year-old may be without a club but was not so foolish as to not prepare for life without a bumper contract, with his tech giant boasting the sizeable sum in assets.

However, Alli will have to hand over £685,362 to the tax man - but this is a drop in the ocean in relation to the eyewatering £7.6million he is set to receive.

The former England international has been without a club for over 19 months, having last been in action for Cesc Fabregas' Como side in Serie A but only played one game, coming on as an 81st minute sub against AC Milan and receiving a red card just nine minutes later.

But Alli has several projects alongside Dele Alli Promotions keeping him busy while he is attempting to get back to full fitness and find a latest club.

He owns and manages a private residential real estate holding tech giant named Future Homes Investments, which owns and rents six properties worth more than £1.5million.

Dele Alli is looking at a very healthy payday after closing down his image rights organization.

The Englishman has played just ten minutes of professional football since February 2023.

The Former Spurs man was forced to wear an Arsenal shirt on his Instagram story after losing a game of EAFC 27 to a fellow streamer.

And his smallest tech giant, Dele Investments still holds £336,267 in assets.

Most recently the former English international has branched out into livestreaming on Twitch with a skateboard, an array of expensive designer bags, and at least 48 pairs of shoes providing his backdrop.

He has already picked up traction on his channel by calling up old teammates such as Harry Kane, Eric Dier and Jack Grealish while live.

And while playing EAFC 27 with other steamers such as IShowSpeed, who recently forced Alli to wear an Arsenal shirt on Instagram after losing a wager to the 21-year-old American.

It is a far cry from his heady days as a player, when Dele twice picked up the PFA Young Player of the Year award and starred for England on their way to the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup.

During an interview in 2023 on The Overlap, he opened up about his harrowing past, having to smoke and sell drugs as young as seven years old and being hung over a bridge by a man from neighbouring estate when he was just 11.

This resulted in the midfielder turning to sleeping pills and alcohol to suppress his feelings and help him through his trauma.

It has been revealed that (ANSA) - ROMA, 17 NOV - "Non ho dubbi che torneremo a essere orgogliosi della nostra nazionale". Al di là del passo falso col Belgio, Gianfranco Zola mostra fiducia nel nuovo cammino intrapreso dagli azzurri a tutti i livelli, dai più giovani a salire fino a Coverciano. Un tempo fantasista in campo, oggi è stato chiamato da Giovanni Malagò a esserlo in federazione dietro una scrivania da coordinatore dei progetti per i giovani del Team Italia, per rilanciare un intero movimento. In un'intervista a Casa Italia, su Rai Italia, l'ex attaccante sardo disegna un quadro generale: "La sconfitta di Bruxelles ci dà l'idea di quelli che sono i parametri fuori: il Belgio è tra le più forti al mondo ma non la più forte, ci dà un'indicazione sugli obiettivi da puntare - analizza -. Come squadra siamo competitivi ma a livello individuale dobbiamo crescere ancora". La ricetta parte dal valorizzare la "grandissima tradizione e conoscenza del calcio" azzurra mettendola a sistema, fino a creare una "metodologia di lavoro di alto livello che parte dai cinque anni fino ai quattordici, un protocollo a 360 gradi che valga per tutti".

Sources indicate that se i risultati delle nazionali giovanili - coordinate da Maurizio Viscidi - sono "ottimi", lo spazio individuato come margine di crescita sta più alla base: "L'idea è di alzare ancora di più il livello sotto le nazionali, nella qualità dell'insegnamento ai nostri giovani - spiega Zola, che con una sua riforma della Lega Pro, di cui è vicepresidente, punta a valorizzare i giocatori under -. È un lavoro enorme ma finora c'è la collaborazione da parte di tutti". Di modelli virtuosi, ammette l'ex attaccante, ce ne sono anche in casa e "serve prendere spunto dal modo in cui altre federazioni hanno lavorato, come la pallavolo e il tennis". La strada intrapresa, per Zola, è quella giusta, ma con una buona dose di realismo "dobbiamo darci del tempo, perché molte nazioni hanno lavorato molto bene negli anni e adesso sono più avanti di noi". (ANSA).

It has been revealed that dopo la sosta per le nazionali, l’Inter riprenderà il suo cammino dalla sfida contro l’Atalanta. Chivu potrà contare su un Esposito in grandissima condizione, in attesa del rientro di Lautaro Martinez.

Sources indicate that “Sicuramente contro l’Atalanta giocherà Pio, stimolato dai 3 gol segnati nelle ultime due esibizioni in Nazionale che l’hanno portato già a superare nella classifica di tutti i tempi Francesco Totti, 10 reti a 9, con appena 15 presenze in azzurro. Esposito era arrivato carico a Coverciano, perché aveva interrotto il digiuno in campionato contro il Como. Ma rientra dal Belgio con il nuovo status di indispensabile. Per il ct Mancini senz’altro, per il mentore Chivu in prospettiva anche. Almeno domenica, quando le alternative offensive sono ridotte, non ci sono dubbi: Bonny è fuori per infortunio, Lautaro riprende oggi ad allenarsi con una certa intensità dopo un mese e mezzo e Thuram ha rinunciato alla Francia per un affaticamento”, sottolinea La Gazzetta dello Sport.

“Ma quanti gol potrebbero segnare i tre attaccanti dell’Inter in campionato? Il bilancio parziale li colloca sullo stesso piano del tridente del Frosinone: 13 reti. Ma il dato è poco credibile: se Thuram più o meno sta rispettando la media consueta, incidendo anzi più del solito nelle partite, Lautaro si è fermato a 4 gol prima di farsi male e Pio è “solo” a 3. Il capitano è il terzo marcatore di sempre nella storia dell’Inter e nelle ultime sette stagioni di Serie A è sempre andato in doppia cifra, superando tre volte quota 20. Pio invece è alla seconda stagione di calcio tra i grandi, il primo anno è arrivato a 7, ma promette di migliorare rumorosamente. Non è un caso che in azzurro stia segnando al ritmo più alto mai tenuto da un calciatore italiano, più di un gol a partita se consideriamo i minuti giocati. La sua evoluzione naturale prevede una crescita esponenziale dei numeri realizzativi. Non è azzardato immaginare che a fine stagione il trio possa sfiorare il numero delle 45 reti complessive, tanto più in una squadra a trazione anteriore che infila oltre 2,5 palloni a partita”.

Industry observers note that “Ovviamente i tre non giocheranno tutti insieme, se non in determinati spezzoni nei quali Chivu deve recuperare un risultato sfavorevole, perché l’Inter è plasmata da più di un lustro sul 3-5-2. Ma le rotazioni potrebbero addirittura migliorare il rendimento dei singoli, motivati e freschi nei momenti decisivi nell’area di rigore. Nel calcio moderno, con le cinque sostituzioni, molto succede nell’ultimo terzo di gara: lo sanno bene proprio i Campioni che in questo inizio hanno raddrizzato cinque volte una situazione negativa, guadagnando addirittura 13 punti su 28 in rimonta. E’ un’abitudine che l’allenatore, ieri premiato con la Panchina d’Oro a Coverciano, sta cercando di estirpare, come svelano gli aggiustamenti tattici che hanno permesso alla difesa di non subire gol contro Feyenoord e Como. Ma osservando la storia da un altro punto di vista, l’attitudine ai ribaltoni è un vezzo e non solo un vizio: solo chi ha grande qualità può cambiare il destino quando sembra tutto perduto”, aggiunge Gazzetta.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that manca circa un mese e mezzo all'apertura della finestra di mercato invernale, e mentre Amorim è pienamente concentrato sulla squadra e sulle competizioni in corso - incoraggiante il percorso in Serie A, da invertire totalmente quello in Europa League - c'è un Cardinale che ha promesso un mercato in cui verranno portati alla base rinforzi significativi. Ci sarà anche la firma di Marcus Krosche, che nei prossimi giorni verrà annunciato come nuovo Head of Football del Club.

Il focus è sicuramente su attaccante e difensore, ma il Milan si guarda continuamente intorno alla ricerca di talenti su cui investire, con la speranza di trovare dei "nuovi" Cisse, preso proprio l'anno scorso a gennaio dall'Hellas Verona per 8 milioni di euro. Il club rossonero, raccontano Fabrizio Romano e Matteo Moretto nell'ultimo video pubblicato sul loro canale YouTube, nelle ultime settimane ha visionato dal vivo Enzo Perez dell'Oviedo, centrocampista offensivo classe 2008. Sullo spagnolo ci sono anche altri club, tra cui Espanyol, Real Betis e Brentford. L'Oviedo ovviamente non vorrebbe privarsene, ma è anche consapevole che la sua cessione potrebbe corrispondere all'affare economico più importante della storia del club. Sarà una pista da continuare a seguire.

Recent findings suggest that È praticamente certo che Camarda andrà a giocare in prestito a gennaio dopo che in questi mesi non ha trovato spazio per mostrare a tutti le sue qualità. Secondo Romano i discorsi col Genoa per l'attaccante 2008 non cono così avanzati: “Camarda a gennaio, a meno di clamorosi di cambio di scenario, andrà via in prestito a giocare. È stato un inizio di stagione in cui lo spazio è stato limitato. È anche giusto che Camarda possa avere più tempo per poter maturare. Intanto ha segnato con l’U21: i segnali arrivano. Si è parlato molto di Genoa, ma non risulta una pista così calda. Ma per lui ci sarà la fila a gennaio”.

It has been revealed that moretto aggiunge che ci sono già tanti club pronti a posizionarsi, e il calciatore prenderà una decisione di comune accordo con il Milan. E soprattutto non bisogna escludere la pista del prestito all'estero: nei prossimi giorni ci sarà più chiarezza, con il calciatore che non vede l'ora di rimettersi in gioco e trovare continuità.

Sources indicate that infine la suggestione Balde: l'esterno del Barcellona, dopo essere stato sul mercato in estate, continua a non giocare. Già nei mesi scorsi Jorge Mendes ha provato a proporlo al Milan, ma le cifre chieste dal club spagnolo non hanno fatto decollare l'operazione. Fabrizio Romano ammette che potrebbe diventare una possibilità per l'Italia solo se il Barça cambiasse formula: “Balde è un nome che può essere protagonista per gennaio. Poi, con grande onestà, è un nome di mercato estero essendo realisti. Ha un ingaggio che supera i 5 milioni netti a stagione. Il Barcellona in estate era disposto a lasciarlo partire, ma voleva un titolo definitivo da 50-55 milioni. Per l’Italia, nonostante Mendes anche col Milan provasse a capire se ci fosse margine, non c’è mai stata una trattativa vera e propria. Anche perché i costi sono decisamente elevati. Oggi Balde continua a non giocare e oggi parlerà con Mendes, in missione a Barcellona per riunirsi col giocatore e la famiglia e capire cosa fare nel mercato di gennaio. Terrei uno spiraglio aperto se dovesse cambiare la formula, perché oggi sono cifre da estero. Ma è un giocatore da tenere sott’occhio, vedremo se Italia o estero”.

  • I Am Naples Testata Giornalistica - aut.

In a recent development, la Gazzetta dello Sport scrive dell’interesse del Napoli per Sebastiano Esposito, giocatore dal Cagliari in prestito con diritto di riscatto al Sassuolo fissato a 10 milioni di euro. L’esterno è tra i primi nomi sul taccuino del direttore sportivo Giovanni Manna e ieri a Castel Volturno il dirigente ha incontrato l’agente del giocatore. I rapporti tra le parti sono ottimi da sempre, ma questo non garantisce un finale da fuochi d’artificio, poiché il Napoli dovrà inserirsi nell’operazione di riscatto dei neroverdi e trattare con il club emiliano. Il presidente Aurelio De Laurentiis avrebbe già detto sì all’operazione, desideroso di un’accelerata. Sebastiano Esposito è un giovane di grande prospettiva, capace di ricoprire più ruoli e vedrebbe nel Napoli la grande occasione della vita, e non un club di passaggio. La pista resta viva, nonostante le difficoltà legate al prestito con riscatto già fissato. L’operazione dipenderà dagli incastri con le uscite e dalla volontà del Sassuolo di ascoltare eventuali proposte.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Egypt will begin their African Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying matches with a new manager after their previous head coach was sacked amid a torrid breakdown of both of his marriages.
  • Hossam Hassan was handed his marching orders on Saturday after an incident in August which saw his two wives embroiled in a vicious fight, captured and shared on social media.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 13:16 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 13:48 EST, 13 November 2026.

Egypt will begin their African Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying matches with a new manager after their previous head coach was sacked amid a torrid breakdown of both of his marriages.

Hossam Hassan was handed his marching orders on Saturday after an incident in August which saw his two wives embroiled in a vicious fight, captured and shared on social media.

Hassan's first wife Howaida El-Gharbawy and his second Dina 'Dan Adam' Mustafa started the argument while at a hotel bar in the upscale Porto Marina resort on Egypt's north coast.

El-Gharbawy and Mustafa were videoed arguing with Hassan in the middle attempting to cool tensions, but the duo came to blows, with punches thrown and hair pulled as screams filled the air.

Such was the stress of the incident that Hassan is believed to have fainted as he tried to separate the two women.

Horrified public onlookers watched as the physical fight grew with relatives of the trio getting involved, and security was called before Hassan was taken to hospital.

Sources indicate that en Égypte, un violent différend a éclaté entre... les deux femmes du sélectionneur égyptien, Hossam Hassan. 🇪🇬😳Le conflit a dégénéré en échauffourée avec coups et tirage de cheveux, avant que des jeunes et des passages n'interviennent dans la bagarre. pic.twitter.com/pvRUSMtAsD.

Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan was sacked this week after a fight broke out between his two wives.

Hassan's first wife Howaida El-Gharbawy and his second Dina 'Dan Adam' Mustafa started the argument while at a hotel in the upscale Porto Marina resort.

The 60-year-old is believed to have fainted while trying to separate the two women.

Both women are believed to have been left with cuts and bruises following the vicious scrap, while Hassan, despite briefly losing consciousness, was left unharmed.

His lawyers later told Sky News Arabia, via the Sun, that he was not suffering a health crisis during the incident, and that he remained in good health.

Sources indicate that but in the days that followed, Hassan started proceedings to divorce El-Gharbawy, who he has been married to for decades. The couple also share three children.

The 60-year-old has a further two children with second wife Mustafa, who Le Parisien alleges also filed for divorce in the days after the footage went viral on social media.

The Egyptian Football Association ensured that Hassan's professional life took a similar nosedive, sharing in a statement that his dismissal was due in part to reputational damage the scandal might be doing to the national team.

'After analysing all the circumstances and events of the past few days, as well as their consequences and the negative impact they have had on the positive image and stability of our national team, the Board of Directors has decided, within the framework of its responsibilities, to dismiss coach Hossam Hassan and his entire technical staff and to end his tenure,' their statement read.

Mustafa's lawyer Mohamed Shams gave an interview on Sky News Arabia claiming that his client had been the victim of a 'premeditated attack'.

'We hoped it wouldn't come to divorce, but things escalated to this level.'.

Hassan married his second wife in 2015, with Egyptian law allowing Muslim men to marry up to four women, providing that any wives have been formally informed that another marriage is to take place.

The law mandates that the husband is also obligated to treat all of his wives equally with regard to housing, financial support and standard of living.

Hassan had been married to his first wife El-Gharbawy for decades, with the pair sharing three of his five children.

Hassan and Mustafa briefly separated four years ago before recoupling before the spat that ended both of his marriages.

As well as being relieved of his duties, Hassan was also sanctioned by the Supreme Council for Media Regulation, leaving him unable to publicly address the media following his sacking.

Mohamed Salah and Co will now play their first qualifier of the international break against Malawi under new head coach Ali Maher.

The former Liverpool star could be among those Pharaohs stars privately pleased with the departure of Hassan, after he was benched by his ex-manager for the last two international clashes.

When asked why the superstar and national team captain had been left on the sidelines for the ties, Hassan had said: 'It is not right for a country of 120 million people for the national team to depend on one player.'.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • This was a kick in the midriff for Manchester United.
  • They profited from the first one with Phil Foden sent off after hitting out at Bruno Fernandes – in retaliation – after he was booted in the backside by the United captain who somehow went unpunished.
  • But then City played three quarters of this 199th Manchester derby with just 10 men and came out on top with the inevitable and outstanding Erling Haaland scoring his ninth goal against United to become the top scorer in Premier League meetings between these rivals.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

This was a kick in the midriff for Manchester United. Not once. But twice. And, then, most painfully, a third time with a dismal, dispiriting defeat.

They profited from the first one with Phil Foden sent off after hitting out at Bruno Fernandes – in retaliation – after he was booted in the backside by the United captain who somehow went unpunished.

But then City played three quarters of this 199th Manchester derby with just 10 men and came out on top with the inevitable and outstanding Erling Haaland scoring his ninth goal against United to become the top scorer in Premier League meetings between these rivals. And that was a far more painful and damaging blow.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

On a day in which thousands of fans protested, accusing co-owners Sir Jim Ratcliffe and the Glazers – with Avram Glazer joining Ratcliffe in attendance – of treating them like “s---”, United unfortunately left a nasty whiff of being just that out on the pitch.

In a recent development, united were frankly, woeful. They lacked belief and imagination and attacking instinct and too many of their players – their apparent big players – went missing when they needed to stand up and take the game by the scruff of the neck. They could not break down City’s defence and failed to be a front-foot team who can dominate the ball. Which is surely what they aspire to be?

They hit the post twice – through Marcus Rashford and Kobbie Mainoo – with efforts from 25 yards. And those two local lads were by far their best players. Without them, United carried so little threat, were so blunt, that it was shocking.

Industry observers note that the question for Michael Carrick, the Manchester United head coach, is simple: what is he trying to do with this team? Can they only ever depend on counter-attacks?

Sources indicate that afterwards Haaland talked about City’s “personality, character” and that was exactly what United lacked. They did not adapt a tactical plan to combat 10-man City’s desire to keep their wingers high and wide, and break with intent and still try and attack.

It was telling that so little did City’s new head coach Enzo Maresca worry about United that he did not add a defensive player, and when he took off Rayan Cherki at half-time, he replaced him with the equally creative Iliman Ndiaye who impressed. Maresca knew United needed space to run in behind and denied them that. It was that simple.

City also struck the post with United goalkeeper Senne Lammens tipping an Enzo Fernández shot against the frame of the goal, and the visitors were worthy winners as they preserved their perfect start to the season to draw level on points with leaders, Arsenal.

City handled the occasion and the – admittedly toothless – opposition superbly under their newly introduced head coach and will clearly be Arsenal’s closest challengers this season.

Industry observers note that maresca delivered a masterclass. For Carrick? This was a disasterclass. An object lesson in how not to use a man-advantage. And now United will have to endure even more City songs after being outplayed at home like this.

Was it complacency? Was it inability? Was it a damning lack of courage, confidence, belief even? On the pitch and in the dugout United were far too passive. This was not how a major team plays and Carrick needs to wake up.

It has been revealed that the former midfielder did so well last season to guide United into Champions League qualification but so far this campaign he has given the impression that his job is done. Rather than that the real work starts now.

In a recent development, there was controversy around the red card and the goal. There is no doubt Foden had to go. But what about Fernandes? He clearly kicked Foden as he was on the ground with the midfielder reacting instinctively, two-footing him in the gut.

It meant he became the first City player to be dismissed in a Manchester derby in the league since Bernardo Corradi in December 2006 and will be punished with a three-match ban for violent conduct.

To make matters worse for Foden, who missed out on the World Cup, it happened in front of Thomas Tuchel who names his England squad for the Nations League campaign on Friday.

Phil Foden is SENT OFF in the Manchester derby! 🟥 pic.twitter.com/sDkHoLMnjL.

Recent findings suggest that and the goal? Initially it was ruled out for offside as Haaland superbly turned in Josko Gvardiol’s cross beyond the far post – he made that tricky finish look routine. But after a lengthy VAR check that decision was overturned by referee Michael Oliver.

According to recent reports, patrick Dorgu had played Haaland onside but the concern then was whether Fernández had touched the ball as he tried to reach the cross. He had not. But even if he had not, surely he was impeding Lisandro Martínez’s attempt to clear? He was certainly in the defender’s line of vision which fits the criteria for the offside to be given as it interfered with an opponent.

United can understandably complain but they can have no excuse. The pressure, already, will be beginning to mount on Carrick with just four points from four league games and down in 13th place. With a Carabao Cup tie at home to Brighton in midweek and a trip to Fulham next Sunday before the international break, he needs wins.

It has been revealed that “We’ve only got 10 men,” goaded the City fans as the game headed into added time and United can expect to hear that again and again. And again.

Industry observers note that even so, at the death, Bryan Mbeumo – as otherwise anonymous as Matheus Cunha – had the chance to equalise after being shrewdly picked out by Fernandes. He was excellently thwarted by Gianluigi Donnarumma. But Mbeumo was clear inside the penalty area and had to score. Not that United would have deserved it. There were boos at the end and understandably so. United were just not good enough.

Industry observers note that I’m confused. We put things in place in the game now. We have people in offices with all the screens for this decision. It’s more worrying about if that’s the interpretation of football now. If that’s the interpretation of not interfering in the game now, that’s really worrying for me. It’s a staggering explanation.

The decision isn’t going to change the season, but it’s had a major impact on the game. That decision wasn’t on us today. It’s up to us to create and score after that. We had moments. Of course it’s up to us to do that, but significant moments in games like that have a big impact.

According to recent reports, we did a lot of things well, it looked like we were growing well into the game. We looked dangerous. We’ll take the positives from the game today and move on well, but we’re not moving on lightly.

In a recent development, we could have created more. That’s an answer for us, but we could have. That’s our second defeat now, since I’ve been in charge, but we’re a good team and we’ll get back to wining ways.

The red card changed the plan of the game but credit to the players because the effort, spirit and togetherness has been brilliant.

[On Foden’s red card] Can be a red card, but in the same action can be a red card for Bruno. It is what it is, we won.

Changed the proposal for us, and changed the plan for them. They are unbelievable in transition, and the moment we are with 10 men we give them no transitions.

When you are able to win a game with 10 players it’s fantastic, when this game is a derby it’s even better.

Last year with Chelsea I had a player sent off here after three minutes, this year 25, hopefully next time we play against 11vs11!

We always knew it was going to be a tough game. What happened with Phil at the start wasn’t good for us, but we remarked at half-time it would make us feel better if we win and we’ve taken three points.

In a recent development, it just gives you more motivation to go on and get the points. It was really tough for us. We had to run more and fight more. We all shone, to a man, and we were brilliant.

Recent findings suggest that he was offside and what I can’t understand is it’s the rules... I went there because he was in front of him because that’s why Haaland was free at the back.

Every season they come to our club and spend an hour and a half explaining the rules, and they seem so confident with that, and then you have five or six people making this mistake. It’s unacceptable.

We have to go home with this injustice.

It has been revealed that haaland speaking on Sky: “We had to go low which is not ideal, we like to keep the ball, to try to score goals but in these times you have to go a bit low and take your chances when possible. We managed to do that well and that indicates personality and character, to keep the ball away at Old Trafford with 10 men.”.

“We had to change the plan a bit, but Enzo gave us a plan where we could play to our different strengths and counter-attack a bit more. For me personally, I just had to be there, to try to wait for a chance, and if there’s a chance, I had to be ready to execute. We also needed fighters in the team, which we have plenty of. Look at our midfield - it’s something they like to do! I’m so, so proud of everyone.”.

And on Donnarumma’s late save: “This wolf in goal giving you so much confidence, he looks a bit like a wolf. He is a mad man but he is a match-winner as well.”.

9 - Erling Haaland is now the top scorer in Premier League games between Manchester City and Manchester United:9 - Haaland (8 apps)8 - Agüero (13 apps)8 - Rooney (21 apps)Domination. pic.twitter.com/EBiifV12st.

City win the Old Trafford derby with 10 men and Enzo Maresca runs down the touchline to celebrate in front of the travelling fans while their players embrace Donnarumma after his late save.

There will be so much analysis of Foden’s red card, but more so how Haaland’s winner stood given the final result. Should Enzo Fernandez have been considered offside?

According to recent reports, but if you are judging performances, City are worthy winners. They defended stoutly, carried a threat and kept the ball well for periods even though they were a man light. United were aimless and froze.

A mammoth victory, and one which perhaps puts the breaks on talk of an Arsenal procession.

What a chance for Mbeumo to equalise! Superb save by Donnarumma, after the United forward was found by a Bruno Fernandes disguised pass into the box. Mbeumo took the ball under his spell and shot with power, but the substantial goalkeeper pushed the shot over the bar.

United have a corner, but Michael Oliver blows for a foul, and that is surely that.

Sources indicate that martinez tries a straight ball towards Sesko, which is too high for the striker. United have perhaps just one more attack in them if they are too salvage a point.

Dalot with another poor cross that flies over everyone in the penalty area. Then Mainoo’s pass in midfield is intercepted by Anderson, and Ndiaye can bring the ball forward for City until he his tackled buy Martinez.

Fernandes drifts a cross behind for a City goal kick, between Sesko and Zirkzee and it looks like United are running out of time and ideas.

Dorgu with another foul on Ndiaye, yet another break in play for City. And there are going to just FIVE minutes of added time, much to Old Trafford’s frustration.

Sources indicate that haaland does well to bring City forward after another United attack breaks down, and Dorgu is penalised for a foul on Ndiaye. Another stoppage follows because the ball hits Michael Oliver. City can see the finish line so, and they would deserve their three points.

United have a corner after Guehi stands firm to block Cunha’s strike from distance. Maguire rises highest in the middle, but no United player gambled on the knockdown and his header drifts wide of the post.

Industry observers note that good work from Anderson against Mainoo in midfield, he receives a big cheer from the City fans. Carrick has thrown attackers on, but United have lost some structure and are not sustaining pressure.

Industry observers note that nico O’Reilly is now on for the closing stages, in place of Fernandez and Carrick has thrown on Zirkzee in place of Marcus Rashford. A United goal now would feel like a goal out of nowhere. City are playing the better football now and they have a corner.

United have lost all sense of momentum, City are keeping the ball for spells and then are happy for the game to be broken up stoppages.

Industry observers note that fernandez goes down looking for a penalty rather hopefully, and Maguire has been booked for his reaction as well as Fernandez for his role in the fracas. More and more time ticks away.

City are showing real resolve as well as quality here, Enzo Fernandez has just won a free-kick in the United half after a foul by Mainoo. The closest United have come in recent minutes was a glancing header wide from Mbeumo.

From that free-kick, Fernandez’s low delivery is close to being converted by Haaland or Guehi.

According to recent reports, it’s a big final 16 minutes here plus injuries for United. You’re at home to your derby rivals who have been down to 10 men since the 23rd minute and you’ve had just two players show up for the mostpart so far - Mainoo and Rashford. The rest are really going to have to lift it.

Fernandes stings the palms of Donnarumma with a strike from outside the box.

In a recent development, we have now had an explanation and evidence of why the goal stood. The VAR check for offside on Haaland found that he was in fact onside by fine margins, and that Fernandez (who was offside) did not affect Lisandro Martinez as he threw himself at a diving header (and missed). The Fernandez element feels the more debatable.

Recent findings suggest that what a final 30 minutes or so of football we have in store now. There will be an air of panic spreading through the United ranks, and Haaland, Ndiaye and Semenyo are still posing a threat.

Haaland and his City team-mates run off to celebrate in front of the away fans including Noel Gallagher.

The goalscorer looked marginally ahead of Dorgu and offside, but the camera angles can deceive. The reasoning for the final decision is not entirely clear.

United fans were goading and laughing at their City counterparts when the goal was initially ruled out for offside but it’s City who have had the last laugh.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

Sky are saying that VAR has concluded the striker is in an “onside position”.

Recent findings suggest that haaland has the ball in the net but the flag is up for offside! Great finish at the back post from Gvardiol’s cross, but the City striker had just strayed offside. There is an ongoing VAR check, though.

Sources indicate that city with a better sequence of passing but it does Ndiaye cannot get a shot away and then Fernandez commits another foul in midfield. Cunha with a poor cross behind for a City goal kick.

He’s been United’s best player by a distance so far this season and Kobbie Mainoo goes very close there to giving United the lead with a fine strike that hits the post. Next passage of play and he releases Rashford in on the left whose shot is pushed out for a corner.

Kobbie Mainoo was INCHES from opening the scoring against Manchester United 🤏 pic.twitter.com/l9v8mlxzk3.

In a recent development, haaland does well to win City a free-kick in the United half after rolling Martinez. City had an early United corner to defend but they did so well. Quite a slow tempo to the game all round.

In a recent development, fernandez’s deep delivery finds the unmarked Dias, and his header deflects behind for a City corner. Maguire heads away, and then Anderson’s cross drifts behind for a goal kick.

Industry observers note that strange moment as the game kicks-off while Sky’s Patrick Davison is still talking to Michael Carrick. He signs off in almost apologetic fashion for distracting the United manager from his job.

Ndiaye on for Cherki, so Maresca opting for a player who can dribble the ball over long distances.

According to recent reports, keane mentioned: “For me, Fernandes is the player who has been violent. I don’t think that is a red card for Foden. Foden is a bit daft, but so is Bruno.”.

A half that will be remembered for one thing and one thing only: Phil Foden’s red card for kicking out at Bruno Fernandes.

United were shading things before that flashpoint, but City will be pleased with their response to the sending off. They have defended well, and posed a threat going forward without executing the final pass or shot.

This is now a different game to the one United were expecting, so perhaps Carrick needs to shuffle the pack.

United win a free-kick about 25 yards from goal after Enzo Fernandez chases his own poor touch and fouls Tielemans.

Rashford to take... cracking hit, up and over the wall but the attempt bounces wide off the post.

Sources indicate that city threaten again after a poor defensive header by Dalot, with Semenyo fizzing in a low cross that is deflected behind for a corner with Fernandez lurking in the six-yard box. United have lost their way in the last 10 minutes, Dalot flagged offside unnecessarily.

United will now be favourites to win this game, but Mainoo was required to block a goal-bound strike from Cherki after a corner was clear. City do have the ammunition to offer a threat on the break. They need the Haaland of his Dortmund days to attack big spaces on the counter.

It has been revealed that old Trafford is delirious because United’s scourge in so many derbies is off for an early shower. But then Foden kicked up from the ground with his studs into the midriff of Fernandes. I don’t think he can have any complaints.

In a recent development, although Foden’s sending off will certainly not have enhanced his prospects! Kicking out in retaliation at being kicked by Bruno Fernandes when he was on the ground.

According to recent reports, england manager Thomas Tuchel and his assistant Anthony Barry are among those in attendance at Old Trafford ahead of Friday’s squad announcement, the first since the World Cup and ahead of the forthcoming Nations League campaign. There are plenty of players on show, on both sides ,who will hope to be in contention including Kobbie Mainoo and Marcus Rashford for United although Harry Maguire may have talked his way out of being considered after his reaction to not making the World Cup squad. For City there is Marc Guehi and Elliot Anderson - who both will be included - and it feels like a significant game for Phil Foden.

Industry observers note that very wasteful from Haaland, after Bruno Fernandes’s stray wall pass back into midfield ran into his path. Neither picked a pass nor let fly with a shot and lost control of the ball.

At the other end, Guehi defends well against Rashford and City have a goal kick, but United have the upper hand in the game at the moment.

Cunha with a burst through City’s midfield and he is brought down by Fernandez. Just before that, City invited the pressure with a stray cross-field pass in their own defensive third which Guehi could not control. Mainoo then whips a teasing cross to the back post, but Rashford misread the flight of it and he was offside in any case.

City with a more sustained spell of possession in the United half, but Martinez defends well as Foden dribbles into the penalty area. Cunha then tries to release Rashford behind the City defence, but Dias covered well behind Guehi to intercept.

Industry observers note that promising counter-attack for United after Rashford pinches the ball off Foden in midfield, and the home team’s attacking quartet of players stream forward. Poor from Cunha though, dragging a shot well wide from an improbable distance.

Quite a composed start from City, Anderson enjoying plenty of touches in midfield. Fernandes tries to sweep a first-time pass out to Rashford wide left, but Nunes intercepts.

Then Fernandes’s next pass is more threatening, lofting a pass over the City defence for the run of Diogo Dalot but he cannot quite put the ball under his spell in the penalty area.

It has been revealed that rashford finds himself near the right touchline and finds room to drive inside with the ball, where he is sandwiched between Semenyo and Anderson. Free-kick for United in a crossing position right of centre, and from the second phase a Martinez cross flies into the gloves of Donnarumma.

An early glimpse of United’s slightly flimsy central midfield with Cherki finding space behind them and Enzo Fernandez’s strike from distance deflecting over the bar. Martinez heads Anderson’s delivery behind for another corner.

This time City take it short, but United clear their lines when the ball is crossed into the box.

The ball changes hands in midfield a couple of times in quick succession. Dalot pressing Semenyo but the winger gets away from him, but United win a challenge before Anderson nips in. Promising start if you want aggression and intensity.

Sources indicate that maguire is then penalised for a foul on Cherki in a more promising position for City, but from a free-kick taken short the flag goes up for offside. City claim there was a foul on Cherki from Fernandes.

United get the first Manchester derby of the season under way.

As expected, there is that banner above the mouth of the tunnel.

“THE WAY YOU TREAT US IS A DISGRACE” banner is displayed above the Munich tunnel on the south west corner of the Stretford End.

Avram Glazer is in the directors’ box with Sir Jim Ratcliffe behind his co-owner.

I say chaos, [but] it can be noise. Embrace it, it’s a derby, it’s nice... Try to play our game!

It has been revealed that we’ve got a lot of encouragement going into the season, of course we wanted more points at this stage. We understand how crucial this game is and what it can do but it’s getting the balance, we know it’s a long season and we have to be consistent over a period of time. In some ways everything is on today, and it has to be, but it’s not everything in terms of the bigger picture.

Recent findings suggest that michael Carrick’s record has been outstanding, particularly at Old Trafford. They’ve been brilliant here and very difficult to beat.

If United drop points today, people will say it’s a bad start, if they win today, people will say they’re back.

If you had read Sam Wallace’s exclusive interview with United’s right-back you would know he was in line to make his 250th appearance for the club. Dalot did not want to take Carrick’s team selection for granted when talking about the milestone, but United’s manager is not replete with full-back options.

If you haven’t checked out the interview, you can have a read here.

Some supporters also targeted ambitions to build a latest 100,000 capacity stadium adjacent to Old Trafford by singing: “You can shove your new ground up your a---.”.

Inside Old Trafford, all flags in the Stretford End are set to be removed with and replaced by one banner that reads: “THE WAY YOU TREAT US IS A DISGRACE.”.

"An absolute WORLDIE from range!"Lewis Dunk scores a contender for goal of the season 🤯 pic.twitter.com/m5bPzm5Wm3.

According to recent reports, struck by the nature of both midfields. If you look over the careers of Anderson-Fernandez-Cherki and Tielemans-Mainoo-Fernandes, Anderson is the only player of the six who has not played as a No 10 or advanced midfielder. The other five are not especially adept at covering ground and defensive actions, so this could well be wide open.

Thousands of Manchester United fans have been marching in protest at the Glazers and Sir Jim Ratcliffe’s running of the club.

Supporters have reacted with outrage to the club’s handling of a controversial anti ticket touting operation they felt unfairly singled out innocent fans.

And thousands have taken to the streets to voice their anger at how they feel they are being treated by the co-owners.

Plumes of red and green and yellow smoke filled the air as fans brandished banners and flags and chanted anti-Glazer and Ratcliffe songs.

“You take it all from fans and banning us for nothing. Premium prices all for greed,” read one banner.

One banner is a Stones Roses-themed number emblazoned with “Jim Aint The One”, a nod to Sir Jim Ratcliffe and the song This Is The One which is played at Old Trafford as the teams emerge from the tunnel.

Enzo Maresca has selected the more attacking option by playing Enzo Fernandez deeper alongside Elliot Anderson, rather than pushing the Argentine up a line and starting O’Reilly or Bouaddi. Still no Doku for City, and Foden has been preferred to Ndiaye out wide.

Manchester City XI: Donnarumma, Nunes, Dias, Guéhi, Gvardiol, Anderson, Fernández, Foden, Cherki, Semenyo, Haaland.

It is a very offensive-minded XI with Dorgu at full-back and a midfield trio of Tielemans, Fernandes and Mainoo behind Mbeumo, Cunha and Rashford. The results could be spectacular, but City should fancy punching holes in that set up.

Man Utd XI: Lammens, Dalot, Maguire, Martinez, Dorgu, Tielemans, Mainoo, Mbeumo, Cunha, Fernandes, Rashford.

Subs: Darlow, Heaven, Mazraoui, Yoro, Mount, Santos, Lacey, Sesko, Zirkzee.

Representing the Reds on derby day... 📋❤️‍🔥COME ON UNITED! 🗣️🗣️🗣️.

Recent findings suggest that they are now 2-0 down against Brighton and Taiwo Awoniyi has been sent off for an elbow. Bar a miracle, it will be zero points from four games for Frank Lampard’s team.

It has been revealed that there will be no flags in the Stretford End today in a protest against ticketing policy which United say is about stopping touts, but loyal, innocent fans may have been caught in the crossfire. A crackdown has led to 685 supporters being stripped of their season tickets and another 464 being sanctioned. Fans will unfurl a giant banner reading “The Way You Treat Us Is A Disgrace” aimed at the club’s hierarchy this afternoon. You can read more here from James Ducker.

"You can shove your new ground up your a*rse"#MUFC protests pic.twitter.com/EMmnF8FhNo.

Kostoulas has given Brighton the lead away at Coventry, who are still to pick up their first Premier League point. Around five minutes until half-time in that one. It was quite some finish.

"What an outstanding finish, absolutely brilliant!"Charalampos Kostoulas fires Brighton in front with a wonderful finish 💥 pic.twitter.com/bMKJACr2bd.

Both of these teams were in Champions League action this week but, as James Ducker explores in this piece, United have missed out in six of the last 13 campaigns. City have been ever-presents, with significant sporting and financial benefits. Over the 10 years between 2016 and 2025, City generated £343m more in broadcast revenue and prize money from European football than their derby rivals.

Sam Wallace was at Carrington this week to speak with Diogo Dalot, the Manchester United right-back who could make his 250th appearance for the club this afternoon. Dalot has been through some tumultuous times at Old Trafford, and is one of the great survivors in the squad. He talks about the scrutiny at United, his musical family and the negatives of social media for young players in an interview you can read here.

My sense is that while United fans generally understand and agree with the decision to stick with Carrick, they hope he is the long-term answer to get the club back to winning the Premier League or Champions League, while the rest of the world doubts it.

To most, it feels like Carrick remains an interim solution in all but name, entrusted with the keys to Old Trafford until a super coach can move in during the summer of 2027. Carrick will not see it that way, of course, but there are certain perceptions which will be tough to shake off.

Good afternoon and welcome to our live coverage of the season’s first Manchester derby, with midfield rebuilds the theme of the summer on both sides of town.

Elliot Anderson, Enzo Fernandez and Ayyoub Bouaddi could all be involved for City, who lost Rodri and Bernardo Silva in the engine room, while United have recruited Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos in an attempt to address a long-standing problem.

Sources indicate that rodri’s departure and a Community Shield shellacking by Arsenal prompted some gloomy forecasts for Enzo Maresca and City, but confidence has grown since. The late turnaround at home to Bournemouth on the opening weekend could well look very vital in a few months’ time, while Crystal Palace and Coventry have also been put away. Victory in Porto was probably Maresca’s most impressive result to date at City, though winning at Old Trafford would usurp that. Three points for City would mean they join Arsenal on a maximum of 12 points from four games.

It has been a patchy start to the campaign for United and Michael Carrick, and this afternoon’s result will go a long way to shaping perceptions of where they are. The concession of a late equalise at Everton, in addition to a dreadful loss at Hull, adds a degree of pressure. United will be buoyed by their performance in this fixture in January, when they delivered possibly the best performance of the post-Ferguson years to slay City in a 2-0 win that could well have been four or five.

It has been revealed that with Tielemans, Bruno Fernandes and Kobbie Mainoo prominent in midfield, United are trying to shift to a more possession-heavy approach, but any success against City in recent times has tended to come on the counter-attack. Maresca’s team have had lots of the ball in their first few games of the season, so that is the expected pattern again.Full team news on the way later.

According to recent reports, come noto, si è svolta ieri, ad Arezzo, la XV edizione del Gran Galà del Calcio – Rever, l'esclusiva manifestazione che celebra il calcio italiano, nell’ambito del Festival del Calcio Italiano e dello Sport. Tra i premiati, Mariano Armonia, responsabile dell’area scouting dell’Avellino, che ha ricevuto il riconoscimento proprio come migliore nel suo ruolo in relazione alla passata stagione del campionato di Serie B.

Sources indicate that un nome da sempre poco esposto, uno che ha iniziato davvero dal basso, fino poi a imporsi come uno dei maggiori protagonisti dello scouting italiano. Schivo e silenzioso, poco incline ai riflettori, ha iniziato la sua carriera come collaboratore del Ds Raffaele Ferrara, con il quale ha operato alla Pro Patria, alla Reggiana e al Pisa, che è stata la svolta per la sua carriera; dopo il divorzio tra il citato Ferrara e il club toscano, infatti, l'allora proprietà nerazzurra - la famiglia Corrado - ha voluto confermare però Armonia, che è stata una scelta vincente. Armonia, che già in terra bustocca aveva strutturato una rete di osservatori, ristruttura il settore giovanile, anche sotto l'aspetto degli osservatori, e da lì, dopo sette anni, la chiamata dell'Avellino, con il lungimirante Mario Aiello che si è voluto avvalere della sua collaborazione: che l'obiettivo degli irpini parta dalla costruzione di un sempre più forte settore giovanile e dalla valorizzazione dei giovani è cosa nota. Chi, meglio di Armonia, poteva fare al caso loro?

Recent findings suggest that sia chiaro, Armonia non ha mai rivendicato la scoperta di calciatori, non si è mai esposto e mai si è preso meriti. Ma gli anni di Pisa hanno scovato da altre squadre elementi del calibro di Lorenzo Lucca, Idrissa Tourè, Simone Canestrelli e Pietro Beruatto. Frutto di un lavoro di sinergia, certo, come accade in ogni lavoro non individuale che funzioni davvero, ma del suo, Armonia, ce lo ha messo.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sul fronte stadio continua il dibattito in Comune.
  • In a recent development, «Non mettiamo in dubbio il fatto che sia Lei che la giunta condividiate l’attenzione da noi espressa nei riguardi dell’impatto sulla salute dei nostri concittadini – premettono i consiglieri, riferendosi alla trasformazione dell’area, alla costruzione del nuovo stadio e alla parziale demolizione del Meazza –.
  • Industry observers note that I consiglieri, citando anche un documento dei medici epidemilogici Isde, sottolineano da parer loro la necessità di considerare l'intera area interessata dalla panificazione e di applicare un'analisi epidemilogica.

Sul fronte stadio continua il dibattito in Comune. Stavolta, secondo quanto riporta Calcio e Finanza, al centro della discussione c'è una lettera firmata da sette consiglieri comunali e indirizzata al sindaco Giuseppe Sala in cui si chiede di sospendere la valutazione ambientale strategica (VAS) per integrarla con una valutazione di impatto sanitario (VIS).

In a recent development, «Non mettiamo in dubbio il fatto che sia Lei che la giunta condividiate l’attenzione da noi espressa nei riguardi dell’impatto sulla salute dei nostri concittadini – premettono i consiglieri, riferendosi alla trasformazione dell’area, alla costruzione del nuovo stadio e alla parziale demolizione del Meazza –. Il tema centrale è che questa attenzione condivisa deve tradursi, per garantire il raggiungimento dell’obiettivo dichiarato, in conseguenti azioni e scelte concrete», si legge nel testo diffuso da Calcio e Finanza.

Industry observers note that I consiglieri, citando anche un documento dei medici epidemilogici Isde, sottolineano da parer loro la necessità di considerare l'intera area interessata dalla panificazione e di applicare un'analisi epidemilogica. La lettera si conclude dunque con una nuova richiesta al sindaco e alla giunta perché «si attivino rapidamente con i soggetti istituzionalmente coinvolti nel procedimento VAS in corso». L’obiettivo dei sette consiglieri resta dunque quello di «sospendere tale procedura al fine di garantirne l’integrazione con una VIS adeguata alla dimensione e all’impatto del piano proposto».

L'ex dt rossonero Geoffrey Moncada, intervenuto al canale “Calcio e Pepe” su YouTube, ha parlato così di Alphadjo Cisse:.

Sugli aspetti più sorprendenti di Cisse: "Tutto quello che riguarda la conduzione della palla, i cambi di direzione... Soprattutto quando era più giovane, riusciva a fare tantissima differenza in questo modo. Ma anche la capacità di utilizzare entrambi i piedi. È sempre più difficile trovare giocatori di questo tipo. È capace di giocare da esterno, ma anche da numero 10, da trequartista, come si dice in Italia, oppure da seconda punta. Quindi deve avere tante soluzioni a disposizione. E in Serie B gli avversari gli mettevano addosso una pressione enorme. Non è passato da un grande club europeo. All'inizio ha giocato in società più piccole. Ed è proprio questo, secondo me, che gli ha permesso di trovare soluzioni da solo e di crescere attraverso le difficoltà. Nessuno gli ha regalato niente, non ha avuto nulla di facile".

Oltre il talento, ci vuole anche un carattere forte: "A volte ci sono dei fenomeni, sai, giocatori talmente forti… Penso a Mbappé e Bernardo Silva, che erano con noi al Monaco. Erano talmente forti che quasi potevano permettersi di 'essere arroganti'. Anzi, a volte è persino meglio. Giocatori come Neymar o Rafa Leão hanno una grande 'arroganza calcistica'. Penso che Alphadjo non sia così. Ha questa umiltà perché viene da quella zona d'Italia, da Verona, perché è passato attraverso piccoli club. Penso che non si renda ancora conto del suo potenziale".

Il marocchino ha una posizione solida, mentre Rovella torna a mettere minuti nelle gambe dopo l’amichevole col Mgarr.

According to recent reports, nicolò Rovella si avvicina al rientro con la Lazio: nell’amichevole contro il Mgarr ha giocato 68 minuti, superando un test importante dopo l’infortunio. Gennaro Gattuso dovrà però gestirne l’impiego con gradualità, a partire dalla prossima partita di campionato contro il Lecce.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Il centrocampista classe 2001 era fermo per l’infortunio riportato il 30 agosto, che lo ha tenuto fuori per buona parte di questo inizio di stagione. La presenza in campo contro il Mgarr, nell’amichevole disputata nei giorni scorsi, ha dato a Gattuso un’indicazione sulle sue condizioni.

Per Rovella, i 68 minuti giocati rappresentano un passaggio significativo nel percorso verso il rientro. Il centrocampista può ora tornare a mettere minuti nelle gambe, senza accelerare i tempi del suo impiego.

Industry observers note that gattuso dovrebbe usare prudenza nella prossima sfida di campionato tra Lazio e Lecce. Come riportato dalla Gazzetta dello Sport, è molto probabile che l’ex centrocampista della Juventus non parta dall’inizio.

Il piano è aumentare progressivamente il suo minutaggio. L’allenatore conosce il valore di Rovella, ma intende gestirne il ritorno in campo dopo il lungo periodo di assenza.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In occasione della terza edizione del premio organizzato a Tolentino, che quest'anno vedrà protagonista l'amministratore delegato del Bologna Claudio Fenucci, il noto procuratore Silvio Pagliari ha parlato a TuttoMercatoWeb.com di diversi temi d'attualità. Qui alcune delle sue considerazioni.

Che campionato di Serie A stiamo vedendo?“Un campionato avvincente, perché fino alla fine non si capisce chi vincerà e chi retrocederà. Le differenze tra le grandi e le piccole si stanno assottigliando. Ci sono sette-otto squadre che possono puntare allo Scudetto, soprattutto le prime tre-quattro. È un campionato sempre più bello. Noi siamo masochisti, parliamo sempre male del calcio italiano, ma chi gira l'Europa come me sa che siamo, se non il primo, sicuramente il secondo campionato a livello europeo”.

Industry observers note that la Roma può essere l'anti-Inter, soprattutto con un grande esterno a gennaio?“È già una grande antagonista dell'Inter, perché è una squadra che lavora ormai da due anni con lo stesso allenatore. Parliamo sicuramente di uno dei più grandi tecnici degli ultimi vent'anni nel calcio italiano. È stato un innovatore: prima si giocava sempre di reparto, adesso giocano tutti uno contro uno. Penso che la Roma possa essere un'antagonista”.

Il Napoli di Allegri sta deludendo le aspettative. Si aspettava una continuità maggiore rispetto al lavoro di Conte?“No, non è riuscito a incidere. Ho visto la sua squadra a Genova, ci sono troppi giocatori sottotono. Non mi sembra che ci sia una grande empatia tra lo staff tecnico e i calciatori, perlomeno fino adesso. Ci aspettiamo tutti di rivedere il Napoli di Antonio Conte, perché sarebbe un altro antagonista. Altrimenti per la Champions ci sarà una grande lotta, mentre per lo Scudetto rischia di essere una corsa a due. Mancano all'appello troppe squadre, dal Milan alla Juventus”.

Fabregas è già tra i cinque migliori allenatori al mondo?“Due o tre anni fa dissi ai miei collaboratori di fare attenzione al Como, perché sarebbe potuto diventare l'outsider per lo Scudetto. Sicuramente Fabregas è uno dei più grandi”.

Che impressione le ha fatto la Nazionale di Mancini, al di là della sconfitta contro il Belgio?“Molto bene, perché Mancini è un grande selezionatore e un grande conoscitore di calcio. Prende giocatori forti, giovani, e ha il coraggio di buttarli dentro. Bisogna dargliene atto, sta facendo un grandissimo lavoro a prescindere dal risultato contro il Belgio. Ha ridato smalto a una situazione che era veramente difficile”.

Quale potrebbe essere il grande colpo del mercato di gennaio?“Se dovesse arrivare uno come Endrick sarei contento, perché il calcio italiano ha bisogno di giocatori forti. Se invece devono arrivare stranieri che non fanno la differenza, allora dobbiamo cambiare registro. Vedo tante partite nelle quali tra i ventidue in campo non c'è neanche un italiano. Mettiamo regole in Serie C e Serie D, quando dovremmo intervenire anche in Serie A. A gennaio, comunque, prevedo pochi movimenti: per fare davvero la differenza servono tanti soldi e in Italia non ci sono molte squadre che possono permetterselo”.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Bruno Fernandes has rejected a new contract at Manchester United against the turbulent backdrop of the departure of head coach Michael Carrick.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 18:28 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 14:42 EST, 13 November 2026.

Bruno Fernandes has rejected a new contract at Manchester United against the turbulent backdrop of the departure of head coach Michael Carrick.

The Manchester United captain publicly questioned the former manager's tactics after his side's Champions League thrashing at the hands of Como, and has struggled to find form this season.

Discussions are believed to have started between Fernandes and Man United over the summer, on the heels of a strong campaign which saw him named Men's PFA Player of the Year.

But after an initial proposal from the club is thought to have been rejected by the midfield talisman, Fernandes has now snubbed a second deal with improved terms, in what could be an early headache for incoming manager Mauricio Pochettino.

The Portuguese international's contract is set to expire in June 2027, which means that if the club and player fail to agree fresh terms, Fernandes will be free to discuss a summer move with clubs abroad as early as the January transfer window.

The club may yet seek to trigger the 12-month extension in Fernandes' contract, but will continue talks over aspects including his salary and the length of his upcoming deal as they are keen for him to stay.

Bruno Fernandes has rejected a second set of terms from Manchester United as the club seeks to pin him down to a new deal.

The club captain inked his latest terms in 2024 with his contract set to expire next June.

Man United currently sit in the relegation zone after a 40-year worst-ever start to the season, and announcing a new deal for Fernandes might have given the club an important boost of morale during a difficult international break.

Fernandes was brought back into the fold after going through a brief period of being frozen out of Carrick's squad following his incendiary comments following defeat in Italy last month.

Fernandes, who is usually very deliberate in what he says in the media, was scathing in his criticism of coaches after the Como debacle.

'It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man and sometimes leave a little space in behind and try to get the ball in the first moment, to wait for them, to give them the ball,' he said.

'But sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confident, they have so many bodies behind the ball that make you run a lot, make people get frustrated, and then obviously when you recover the ball the legs are, and the brain, much more difficult to make it work.'.

In a recent development, his post-Como interview was widely condemned by fans and pundits alike, with Gary Neville lamenting: 'If that's your captain saying that, imagine what they're saying in the dressing room behind closed doors when no one's listening. That's horrific.'.

He also told Fernandes to 'read the room' and accused him of being an 'excuse merchant' on his podcast.

Fernandes was left on the bench for Man United's next Premier League appointment, a loss to Bournemouth, before returning to the starting XI against Chelsea the following matchday.

After Man United's comeback win against Roma, Fernandes was defiant in his post-match remarks as he stressed that he had not been sanctioned for undermining Carrick with his initial interview.

It has been revealed that 'The club needed that win. The players needed that win. It is something we needed as a group of players and staff,' he mentioned. 'We have been working so hard to get out of this situation together. It has been tough. There has been a lot of speculation in the media.

Fernandes was publicly critical of his former head coach Michael Carrick last month but was later adamant that he had not held clear-the-air talks with him.

'A lot of lies around many things that have happened at this club, between me and the manager, like that we have cleared the air. Nothing like that happened.

Sources indicate that 'The manager took a decision of making myself on the bench because I wasn't performing. And that's fair.

It has been revealed that 'Everyone felt like that was a punishment for the words that I had [after Como]. And if it was, it was right.

'The manager makes the decisions. I have to accept it. I have to go forward with that. It doesn't change the belief I have in the manager, the staff and every player at this club.

'And it doesn't change my aim to win every f***ing game that I have ahead of me.'.

Fernandes' sabre-rattling was ultimately unable to keep Carrick in his job however, with the former club captain finally sacked on Thursday after an agonising three-day wait.

Man United's hierarchy, notably chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox, have come under fire from the fanbase and within the club for their treatment of the departing coach, with Carrick taking two days of training at Carrington as they mulled his sacking.

Wilcox and Berrada jetted to Monaco earlier this week to meet with Ineos chief Sir Jim Ratcliffe and discuss the departure of Carrick, with the club's Glazer ownership ratifying the decision to replace him with United States national team coach Pochettino.

Daily Mail Sport reported on Thursday evening that staff members inside the club have been upset with the protracted sacking, which has been deemed disrespectful of Carrick's status as a club legend.
